description: Restore a stash and drop it on success. Conflicts leave the entry in the list.

options.summary: Try to restore the saved staging state
options.detail: Restore the saved index as well as working-tree changes. Conflicts can prevent the index from being restored. On Git 2.53 and current upstream, stash.index=true enables this by default. Git 2.43 requires the switch.
Errors are still reported. --no-quiet cancels quiet mode.
Errors are still reported. --no-quiet cancels quiet mode.
--help prints the same usage after this subcommand. --help-all requests the full option list. Both Ubuntu packages print the same text for all three spellings.

options.summary: Restore changes without recreating the saved staging state
options.detail: Overrides --index and, on Git 2.53 and current upstream, stash.index=true. A conflict can still leave unmerged index entries.
